description: Which segment counts a call or tool recorded while a pause or the final end delivers events. Usage recorded during pause delivery belongs to the paused segment, counted once, with its own call and tool events; the final end refuses it, as any write after end. A tool with an ID and no outcome whose agent made no later call is what a pause waits on: the segment that runs it counts it, once, and sends its declared event.

cases.name: wrapper call recorded during paused call delivery
cases.description: A held span call event is delivered by pause; the app's transport callback records another call. The paused segment counts both.

cases.name: span call recorded during paused call delivery
cases.description: The late call is a held span too, so pause delivers it in the same pass before capturing totals.

cases.name: call recorded during paused call delivery, then JSON restore
cases.description: Nothing recorded during delivery is left pending in the snapshot.

cases.name: settled tool recorded during paused call delivery
cases.description: A tool recorded with its result during delivery counts in the paused segment and sends its declared event once.

cases.name: span answer recorded during paused call delivery
cases.description: The paused response keeps the answer captured before delivery; a span answer recorded by the callback does not replace it.

cases.name: span answer recorded by a tool event during paused call delivery
cases.description: A tool recorded during delivery sends its declared event at pause; a span answer its callback reports does not replace the answer captured before delivery.

cases.name: span recorded by a tool event during paused call delivery
cases.description: Delivery records a tool whose declared event, sent at pause, reports a held span; pause delivers that span's call event too before capturing totals.

cases.name: nested spans recorded during paused call delivery, then another span
cases.description: Delivery of the held call records a parent span and its child; the parent is filtered as the child's nested twin, and delivery of the child's event records one more span. Every counted call sends its event before the totals are captured.

cases.name: nested spans recorded during paused call delivery, then another span, then JSON restore
cases.description: The same run continued from the JSON snapshot: nothing recorded during delivery is left for, or sent again by, the restored run.

cases.name: overflow calls recorded behind a held span during paused response delivery
cases.description: With max_calls_per_interaction 1, delivery of the paused response records a span, whose call event is held, and two calls past the cap. They are pending for the next segment, and the folded pair sends one call event after the span's.

cases.name: overflow calls recorded behind a held span during paused response delivery, then JSON restore
cases.description: The same run continued from the JSON snapshot: the folded pair's unsent call event is restored with the pending calls and sent once.

cases.name: call recorded during final call delivery is not counted
cases.description: The final end delivers a held span call event after the interaction ended, so a call the callback records is refused, as any write after end is.

tool awaiting approval, resumed in process
cases.description: A tool with an ID and no outcome, requested by its agent's latest call, is what the pause waits on: the paused segment leaves it out and sends no event for it. Its execution after resume counts it once, in the resumed segment, with its real outcome.

cases.name: tool awaiting approval, then JSON restore
cases.description: The awaited tool is written to the snapshot's pending_tools and merges with its execution after restore.

cases.name: awaited tools of several agents
cases.description: A tool waits only on its own agent's next call. The planner's tool is followed by a later planner call, so the paused segment counts it as unknown. The researcher's tool has no agent of its own and takes the preceding researcher call's; no researcher call follows it, so it is carried and counted after resume.

cases.name: parallel branches awaiting approval, then JSON restore
cases.description: Two agents each wait on a tool at the pause. Both are carried through the restore and counted after it with their own outcomes.

cases.name: awaited tool of a run that never resumes
cases.description: The tool never ran: it is never counted and sends no event.

cases.name: wrapper-only tools without results
cases.description: A wrapper records the tool IDs of each call and never their results. At the pause, the earlier call's tool counts as unknown; the latest call's tool is carried and counts as unknown at the resumed segment's end.

cases.name: awaited tool resolved by record_tool_result after JSON restore
cases.description: An outcome reported for the tool's ID after restore merges into the carried tool.

cases.name: awaited tool resolved by record_tool_result after in-process resume
cases.description: The caller pauses its own interaction while a tool waits, resumes it in process, then reports the outcome: counted once in the resumed segment with its real outcome.

cases.name: awaited tool re-evaluated at later pauses
cases.description: A carried tool starts the next segment before every new call and is evaluated again at each pause. Another agent's call leaves it waiting; its own agent's later call (the researcher's, taken from the call that preceded it and kept through the JSON restore) makes that pause count it as unknown.

cases.name: awaited tool given an agent later, then JSON restore
cases.description: A tool recorded without an agent after an agentless call takes the empty agent key and keeps it when a later record names its agent. The snapshot writes that key as an empty agent_key, so the restored run, like the in-process one, counts the tool at the next pause, after another agentless call.

cases.name: awaited tool given an agent later, resumed in process
cases.description: The in-process twin of the case above: the tool keeps the empty agent key, so the agentless call after the resume ends its wait.

cases.name: awaited tool of a run cancelled while paused
cases.description: The approval is denied and the app ends the run as cancelled without resuming it. The tool the pause waited on never ran: no segment counts it and no declared event is sent.

cases.name: awaited tool of a run ended while paused
cases.description: A plain end while paused is not a resume either: the tool the pause waited on is never counted and sends no event.

cases.name: denial recorded while paused, then the run is cancelled
cases.description: Of two tools the pause waits on, one is reported denied while the run is still paused: it has an outcome, so the final segment counts it and sends its event. The other never ran and is never counted.

cases.name: agentless call named by its span twin before its tool
cases.description: A wrapper reports a call without an agent and the span twin of that call names the researcher. The tool recorded next has no agent of its own and takes the researcher's, not the stale empty key, so the researcher's later call ends its wait and the paused segment counts it.

cases.name: agentless call named by its span twin after its tool
cases.description: The other arrival order: the tool is recorded right after the agentless wrapper call and the span twin names the researcher afterwards. The tool took that call's agent, so it follows the call to the researcher, whose later call ends its wait.

cases.name: span twin names another agent than the tool's later caller, then JSON restore
cases.description: After a JSON restore, the span twin names the planner for an agentless wrapper call. The tool recorded after it takes the planner's key, so a later agentless call no longer ends its wait: it is carried through the next restore and counted when it runs.
